source_review.finding: The old production plan allocates phase, per-phase and device Vec backing during begin_node_shutdown under its masking coordinator guard. Its parent Drop looks up/aborts domains and later destroys phase backing; device Drop logs. This is source-confirmed; no general heap-exhaustion failure was induced.

Existing stale-page, rejected abort, failed reclamation and poll-claim probes remain enabled in the ordinary suite.

limits: No finding disposition changes; no sustained pressure/fairness, full heap accounting or arbitrary outer-context qualification.
Shutdown worker creation/publication still uses mandatory spawning; later teardown admission and readiness are separate work.
Abandonment is terminal retention, not recoverable custody, physical-release proof or replay authority.
Isolated shutdown checks actual object-store and three device-adapter flush/reset/quiescence, not outstanding-I/O fault recovery or physical platforms.
Ordinary ARM ran before the isolated-only main cfg correction; its ordinary-profile selection and storage code are unchanged.
Temporary full traces and QMP/LLDB snapshots are not version-controlled; the relevant failure signature, result and artifact identities are preserved here.
